text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm shopping at the mall, I
see Mejiro
Dober and Mejiro Ryan
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: How's that one taste?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's good. Everything we've tried has
been tasty.
Could I have a moment
before I decide?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sure! Take all the time you need. Why
don't we
go try those samples next?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... It's not really any of your
business. I'm
just getting a gift for this
lady I know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello Trainer. I received a gift from a
lady I
know, so we're here to get her
something in
return.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We decided to get her something sweet,
but
everything's so yummy, we're having
a tough time
deciding. Haha.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We decided to get her something sweet,
but
everything's so yummy, we're having
a tough time
deciding. Haha.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If we were looking for something that
pairs well
with tea, I would've been able
to choose
immediately, but I feel so
indecisive...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's natural to fuss over a gift for
someone you
care about, 'specially since
you're so considerate
about others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Me, considerate? What are you talking
about?
You're just teasing, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
In any case, we need to decide what to
get. I
won't stop trying samples until I'm
confident in my
choice!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
In any case, we need to decide what to
get. I
won't stop trying samples until I'm
confident in my
choice!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... The last person I need lecturing
me is you,
but I guess you're right...
choice_data_list: Aren't you eating a bit too much?
Aren't you eating a bit too much?
Let's devour it all and judge every bite!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Y-you might be right... I've
already eaten
a lot...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
How about we switch gears and forget
about food
altogether, then? You can
get her some cool
knickknacks or
essential oils instead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
How about we switch gears and forget
about food
altogether, then? You can
get her some cool
knickknacks or
essential oils instead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I like that idea. Let's see what the shops
have to
offer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, they're able to avoid overeating
and
manage to find a proper present.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
All right! The perfect treat for her is sure
to be
out there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We still haven't checked out the
macaron place,
the tart place, or the
Japanese sweets place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Right. I want to compare them with the
first
dessert we tried, so I'd like to circle
back there,
actually...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing! I'll come with! Let's find the
best
dessert for her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Mejiro Dober manages to
choose the
perfect treat... but ends up
overeating.
